tests.description: Stand-it-up steps, mapped to the local CLI build over the fixtures directory.

steps.description: Validate a folder with no setup: walking a directory of mixed fixtures fails (exit 1). Excludes the dd/ support fixtures so the walk is deterministic regardless of what lands there.
No positional paths and no config is an operational error: exit 2 with a clear message.
The CI command shape: `--format github` turns failures into inline annotations and still fails.
